description: Dev Concepts Volume 1 teaches essential competencies for addressing practical development challenges and cultivating a productive mindset in software engineering. This 100-page e-book draws from 15 years of professional experience to guide you through the software craft, emphasizing that 'being a software crafter is much less about technology than about personality traits and psychology.' Part of a comprehensive 12-volume series covering all aspects of software development.
